title: אנבידיה מכה את התחזיות: זינוק של 103% בהכנסות

cluster.headline: דו"ח ראשון מאז הטלטלה: אנבידיה עקפה את התחזיות; ההכנסות זינקו ב-103%
דו"ח ראשון מאז הטלטלה: אנבידיה עקפה את התחזיות; ההכנסות זינקו ב-103%
cluster.note: appears to be the identical syndicated TheMarker article embedded in Haaretz's tmr section

fetched_notes: Revenue up 103% to $115.8bn (headline rounds to $116bn), for Q3 fiscal 2026 ('הרבעון השלישי של 2026'). Analyst consensus was $109bn (beat). Data center revenue $107bn vs $101.8bn forecast, >90% of total revenue. EPS $2.47 (in line). Gross margin 74%. Edge Computing revenue $8.2bn, +42% YoY. Q4 guidance $130bn ±3% (excl. China sales). Expected Q4 GAAP gross margin 71-72%, opex ~$11bn (up from $8.8bn in Q3). Company forecasts 75% revenue growth next fiscal year. Hopper-chip sales to Chinese data centers ~$2.4bn. Board raised buyback by $150bn. Stock +2.2% after hours; market cap ~$3.76 trillion after falling ~30% over the past month amid the 'Huang scandal'. Source: article attributes figures to Nvidia's Q3 reports and earnings call plus news agencies; does NOT name a specific SEC filing/form, and does not state the prior-year comparable quarter's revenue figure from which the 103% growth is calculated.
